The plate looks like a paper plate of about 20 cm. It holds roughly 8 roasted potato chunks, each about 4-5 cm long and 15-20 g, so about 130-150 g in total. Roasted potatoes run about 1.1-1.5 kcal/g, and a little oil pushes that toward the upper end. I'll use about 1.2 kcal/g, which gives roughly 170 kcal.
